about.description: I'm Sambit Sourav, a web developer from India with a deep interest in building things that live on the internet. I enjoy the full journey — from designing the structure of a page to deploying it live. Currently leveling up my skills one project at a time.

projects.title: DevLink
projects.description: A developer bookmark manager to save, tag, and search useful links. Built with vanilla JS and local storage.

projects.title: AetherCast
